title: On the Origins of Varying Gauge Couplings
summary: Variations in the gauge couplings of the Standard Model have been searched for experimentally and proposed as solutions to open questions in fundamental physics. Varying gauge couplings can arise from a dynamical scalar field coupled to the gauge kinetic term. This mechanism has been invoked extensively, assuming a minimal linear coupling of the scalar to the gauge bosons. In this work, we investigate how this operator is generated from the ultraviolet perspective.
